notes: Closure warnings you can trust. Every closure-risk score now names where it came from, and shows nothing rather than inventing one — a pub with no score no longer reads as a pub with a good score. Sixteen pubs have lost an At Risk warning they hadn't earned. One score, one wording, everywhere. Plus: the Radar's empty states say what they're actually looking for, Quick Picks are editable from the sheet, and area search keeps the location you chose.
